items.name: route-transition
items.title: RouteTransition
items.description: Renders <Outlet/> inside React <ViewTransition> so route changes animate as YoRHa panel motion. Disabled when data-motion is reduced or off.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Needs React 19.3+ (stable ViewTransition) and navigation inside a transition (RouterProvider does this). Replaces react-router's deprecated viewTransition APIs; never calls document.startViewTransition.
